translation.name: Kameethari Ñaantsi: ikenkitha-takoitziri awinkatharite Jesucristo; Owakerari aapatziya-wakagaantsi

content: Koriki rotyaantaitziniriri roiteshiretaitairi
Iroñaaka nosankenatakoteri apiyotziri koriki otyaanteniriri ikaatzi roiteshiretaitairi. Nonkamantemiro okaatzi nokamantakeriri Galacia-satzi.
Arika papatotapiintaiyaani, ontzimatye pookayete eepichokiini tzimimotzimiri. Eero nopankenatantapaakawo naaka, nareetapaakemirika pinampiki.
Arika nareetakemi kantacha pamine aanakerine koriki janta Jerusalén-ki intsipataanakero nosankenarepaini.
Ari nontsipatanakyaari niyaate naaka janta, añaawakero ari nimatakero.
Ikenkithashiretari ranteri Pablo
Eerowa nareetzitzimi, tema netapaintatyeeyaawo niyaate Macedonia-ki, irojatzi nimpoitantapaakyaawo pinampiki.
Arika nareetapaakemi, aamaaka osamani nisaikimotanakemi, ari nonkyaawontsitakote. Irojatzi potyaantantainari tsikarika nokowiro niyaate.
Te nokowiro naaka eepichokiini onkantya nareetemi. Iriirika Awinkatharite shinetenawone, osamani nisaikimowaitapaintemi.
Ari nisaikawake jaka Efeso-ki, irojatzi areetantakyaari kiteesheri roimoshirenkaitzirowa “Owiitaantsi”.
Iroowa nimatantyaawori jiroka, tema tzimatsi jaka osheki nantawaitainiri Awinkatharite, kameetha okanta noñaakero. Tzimake osheki koshekaminthatakenari.
Arika rareetakyaame Timoteo, paakameethatawakeri, tema irijatzi antawaitainiriri Awinkatharite, ari roshiyana naaka.
Te onkameethate intzimayete janta manintawaiterine. Iro kameethatatsi paapatziyawakyaari, irojatzi ripiyantaiyaari naakaki. Tema oyaawenta nowakeri ripoke intsipayetakyaari itsipapaini Iyekiite.
Iriima iyeki Apolos, nokantakeri intsipatanakyaari ikaatzi notyaantaimiri eerokapaini. Iro kantacha te ikowi riyaate irirori. Añaawakeroota arika rimatakero paata.
Weyaantawori wethataantsi
Paamaawentaiya eerokapaini, poisokerotyaawo pikemisantanakeri, shirampari pinkantanakya, pishintsishireyete.
Etakotanewo pinkantawakaiya, paapatziyawakaantaiyaawo oitarika.
Iyekiite, piyotziri eerokapaini saikapankotziriri Estéfanas, iriiyetake etanakawori ikemisantanake pinampiki Acaya. Ikamaitanaawo iriroripaini rantawaiwentanairi roiteshiretaitairi.
Noshintsineentemi eerokapaini pinkemisantairi iriroripaini, ari poshiyaari eejatzi itsipatakari rantawaitaiyini, kamaitanaawori.
Osheki nokimoshiretake noñaakero rareetakena Estéfanas, itsipatapaakari Fortunato, eejatzi Acaico. Iriitake owakowentapaakemiri eerokapaini tera onkantya pareetaina jaka,
potapishiretantenari. Iriiyetake otapishiretapaakemine eejatzi eerokapaini janta. Pimpinkathayetawairi.
Riwethayetzimi apatowentapiintakariri Pawa jaka Asia-ki. Riwethatzimi eejatzi Aquila eejatzi Priscila. Riwethatzitzimi eejatzi ikaatzi piyowentapiintakariri Pawa ipankoki.
Riwethatzitzimi eejatzi itsipa iyekiite. Etako pinkantya piwethatawakaayetaiya.
Jiroka, naakaga osankenatajaantakerori nakoki, niwethatzimi. Naakatake Pablo.
Rowasankeetairi kaari nintayetairine Awinkatharite. Ripiyitaiya intsipaite Awinkatharite.
¡Onkamintha ineshironkayetaimi Awinkatharite Jesucristo!
Netakotzimi maawoini eerokapaini, iri Cristo Jesús matakainawone. Ari onkantaitaatyeeyaani.

footnotes.text: Kantakotachari jaka “papatotapiintaiyaani”, irojatzi ikantaitzitari “etapiintawori kiteesheri awisayetzira tominko.”
